title: Scald the teapot
html_source: Preheat your teapot or cup by adding a little scalding water. Empty the teapot or cup. Add the tea, and then add boiling water.

anchor.prefix:
r: her striped petticoat, tossed soiled linen: and lifted all in an armful on to the foot of the bed. 

 As he went down the kitchen stairs she called: 

 — Poldy! 

 — What? 

 —
anchor.suffix:
. 

 On the boil sure enough: a plume of steam from the spout. He scalded and rinsed out the teapot and put in four full spoons of tea, tilting the kettle then to let water flow in
